$comment: Components that are neither Rust crates nor npm packages, for scripts/generate-notices.sh. A version of the form @name is read from the build inputs (scripts/notices.js); an empty one comes from the Ubuntu 24.04 build host. texts are files relative to the repository root, @opus-copying is the COPYING file of the libopus source vendored by opusic-sys.

components.name: Mumble protocol and plugin interface
description: The protocol definition files in proto/ (Mumble.proto, MumbleUDP.proto) are taken
from the Mumble project. The official Mumble game plugins that Mumcord can load at
runtime to read game positions are developed by the Mumble project under the same
license; they are not part of this repository. Mumcord's plugin host
(crates/positional/src/plugins/) follows the plugin interface definitions of the
Mumble project (MumblePlugin.h and the headers it includes). Mumcord is compatible
with Mumble but is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Mumble project.

components.name: libopus
description: Opus voice codec, compiled from the source vendored by the opusic-sys crate.

components.name: libvpx
description: VP9 (and VP8) screen-share encoder and decoder, linked by crates/screenshare.
Statically linked into the Windows app (vcpkg build) and the macOS and Linux apps
(built from the libvpx release source), so it is part of every Mumcord build.

components.name: SQLite
description: Compiled in by libsqlite3-sys (feature "bundled", via rusqlite) and statically
linked into Mumcord.

components.name: PipeWire and libspa
description: Wayland screen capture and audio on Linux. Loaded from the system (the AppImage uses
the host's PipeWire daemon).

components.name: GStreamer
description: GStreamer core libraries from the Ubuntu 24.04 build host, bundled in the AppImage so
WebKitGTK can play video in watch parties. The .deb, .rpm and Arch packages do not
contain GStreamer; they depend on the distribution's packages.

components.name: GStreamer Base Plugins
description: The plugins of gst-plugins-base, bundled in the AppImage.

components.name: GStreamer Good Plugins
description: The plugins of gst-plugins-good, bundled in the AppImage. Plugins that implement
H.264 and H.265 (gst-libav / FFmpeg, x264, x265, OpenH264) and GPL-only codecs
(a52dec, dtsdec, mpeg2dec, libdvdread, faac, faad) are deliberately not bundled
(scripts/filter-gst-plugins.sh); the AppImage plays YouTube through VP9.

components.name: GStreamer Bad Plugins (opusparse)
description: Only the Opus parser of gst-plugins-bad, bundled in the AppImage: without it WebKit
reports no playable audio format for YouTube.

components.name: WebKitGTK and JavaScriptCoreGTK
description: The web view that renders Mumcord's interface on Linux. Bundled in the AppImage from
the Ubuntu 24.04 build host.
